_doc: Official Records Ser. I vol. 27 parts 1-3: scan leaf and printed page of every character offset of the local djvu text. leaves = [leaf, first character offset, printed page or null]; an offset belongs to the last leaf that starts at or before it. Built by tools/bt/kit_or27_leafmap.py from the per-leaf OCR text and the page-number list published with each archive.org item. The printed page is the item's own assertion per leaf; check shows how it agrees with the running heads.
